name: hcfmailer-plus
description: Self-hosted email newsletter application based on Mailtrain

scripts.dev: concurrently -n infra,client,server -c cyan,green,yellow "npm run dev:infra" "npm run dev:client" "npm run dev:server"
scripts.dev:infra: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && docker compose -f docker-compose-develop.yml up
scripts.dev:client: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && npm run dev --workspace=client
scripts.dev:server: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && npm run dev --workspace=server
scripts.dev:zone-mta: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && npm run start --workspace=zone-mta
scripts.dev:restore:s3: set -a && source .env.dev && set +a && npx tsx scripts/dev-restore-s3.ts
